messages:
elaine: Quick preflight — Marketing needs the final changelog + docs links for the launch post. Target publish Tue 09:30 PT originally, but need engineering confirmation on freeze/canary. cc @sam @priya
sam: Changelog draft is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/posts/pull/432 — PR description has the bullet list we'll use. I will push docs links after staging deploy passes.
priya: Docs staging is up: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/v0.9.2 — walkthrough + migration notes are live. Still adding one short example for embeddings routing.
release-bot: release-bot: Canary deploy started for `release/v0.9.2` on staging — 3 nodes. CI passed: 14/14 checks.
mike: Heads up — small runtime change (kv-cache eviction tweak) is queued in `eng-runtime` and might land before canary ends. Requesting we hold public rollout until 12:00 PT to avoid perf variance.
elaine: OK adjusting timeline. New publish target 12:30 PT. Marketing needs final benchmark numbers by 11:30 so the web copy doesn't overclaim. @sam can you confirm numbers?
sam: Benchmark summary (draft):
```
median latency p50: 42ms (opt-3, batch=8)
p99: 128ms
throughput: 900 req/s per pool
cost delta vs baseline: -28%
```
Numbers taken from `bench/opt3-run-2026-03-20`. This is the table we can quote with a short caveat.
priya: I'll lock the docs example and add the changelog snippet. Final docs link will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v0.9.2 by 12:00 PT.
sales-ops: Routing note — once published, trigger the Marketing->Sales lead flow. Use tag `launch:v0.9.2` so SFDC campaign picks them up. I'll prepare the routing rules and notify CS.
elaine: Webinar note — schedule a short 20m demo + 10m benchmarks Q&A on Wed. Webinar copy should use the same benchmark phrasing. @mike confirm we can present "~2x latency reduction at batch=8" — don't want to promise wrong config.
mike: Confirmed internally: roughly ~2x vs our previous 16-bit baseline for typical seq lengths (<=512) when using `opt-3`. Add caveat: results vary by sequence length and model size.
devex-bot: devex-bot: Docs link check passed: internal links resolved, examples compiled.
elaine: Great — action items:
- @sam publish changelog + confirm benchmark numbers by 11:30 PT
- @priya publish final docs link by 12:00 PT
- @mike freeze runtime merges until 12:00 PT
- @sales-ops prepare SFDC routing and campaign tag
We'll push at 12:30 PT. :party-parrot:
sam: Ack — I'll post the final changelog and a short PR comment with the suggested copy for marketing.
priya: Ack — will DM the final URL here when live.
mike: Freezing merges now. Will only unfreeze after post-canary confirmation.
